title: Research Science Institute (RSI)
description: Cost-free summer STEM coursework and mentored original research hosted at MIT.
eligibility: High-school juniors / one year before graduation; US citizens and permanent residents apply directly; international selection depends on participating country.
lifecycleEvidence: Applications for RSI 2026 are now closed. No late applications will be considered. No 2027 dates in inspected pages.

title: Summer Science Program
description: Five-week residential team research in astrophysics, biochemistry, bacterial genomics or cell biology; need-blind admission and need-based support.
eligibility: Current high-school juniors, ages 15–18 during program, with track-specific coursework; domestic and international applicants. Free at family income $75,000 or less assuming typical expenses/assets.
lifecycleEvidence: Applications are now closed for Summer Science Program 2026. Interest form for 2027 exists; no exact 2027 dates announced.

title: MIT PRIMES-USA
description: Free, year-long mentored mathematics research, including theoretical computer science and computational biology.
eligibility: US-resident high-school sophomores and juniors outside Greater Boston; local students use MIT PRIMES. Advanced mathematical preparation expected.
location: Remote, United States outside Greater Boston
lifecycleEvidence: An application link for the 2027 cycle will appear on this page in September 2026. Exact opening day and 2027 deadline not yet published.
